craft_notes: Sthāyin: Rati for sight and stay (abhilāṣa) settling into praise. End-dash→colon (shelter taken, praise released). Rejected: 'swill' for 'quaff' — coarse; kept quaff. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Hail, hail — to Śiva said — mantled in chant-force they shelter:
laudable they, bent to quaff Śāmbhavī weal.
l4.sanskrit_cite: namo namaḥ śivāyeti mantrasāmarthyam āśritāḥ ślāghyās te śāmbhavīṃ bhūtim upabhoktuṃ ya udyatāḥ

reads_against.argmap: Bow, bow — 'to Śiva' thus said: by mantra-power taking refuge. → Praiseworthy are those striving for Śāmbhavī fortune by mantra-power.
c1_essence: Mantra refuge praised; every path, word, meditation is the Lord.
reads_against.c1_rasa: bhakti-śānta with abhilāṣa (longing to see and stay)

l2.plain_english: Bow, bow — 'to Śiva' thus said: by mantra-power taking refuge, praiseworthy they who strive to enjoy Śāmbhavī fortune.
l2.sanskrit_cite: namo namaḥ śivāyeti mantrasāmarthyam āśritāḥ ślāghyās te śāmbhavīṃ bhūtim upabhoktuṃ ya udyatāḥ

l3: Hail, hail — 'to Śiva' — mantled in chant-force they shelter;
laudable they, bent to quaff Śāmbhavī weal.
reads_against.t1: Homage, homage, to Śiva — by mantra-power taking refuge: praiseworthy those who strive to enjoy your Śāmbhavī bhūti.
